items.title: Cunk on Cinema
items.synopsis: Philomena Cunk will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?
items.brief: Philomena Cunk will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema.

items.title: Alan’s Universe

items.title: El crimen de Pazos
items.synopsis: In the quiet village of Pazos, Aniceto and his wife Irene appear to be the perfect couple until one night, when she suffers a brutal attack during an apparent robbery. As she fights for her life in the hospital, Elías, a sergeant in the Civil Guard who is convinced that Aniceto is the perpetrator, faces a system he perceives as unwilling to heed his warnings or protect the victim. With Aniceto free and Irene's life hanging by a thread, will the truth come to light before it's too late?
items.brief: Documentary about a woman attacked in her home and the investigation.

items.title: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza

items.title: Die Kaiserin (Season 3)
items.synopsis: When the rebellious Elisabeth ("Sisi") meets Franz, the Emperor of Austria, the young couple's intoxicating love completely upsets the power structure at the Viennese court. After the wedding, the young empress must assert herself not only against her mother-in-law, the sovereign, power-hungry Sophie but also against Franz's brother Maxi, who himself longs for the throne (and for Sisi). As enemy troops form upon the borders of the Habsburg Empire, people in Vienna rise up in protest against the emperor. Elisabeth must find out who she can trust and how high the price is to be a true empress and a figure of hope for the people.
items.brief: When the rebellious Elisabeth ("Sisi") meets Franz, the Emperor of Austria.

items.title: Bros (Season 2)
items.synopsis: After receiving some shocking news, two best friends travel from Jerusalem to Krakow for a football match, hoping to leave their troubles behind.
items.brief: After receiving some shocking news, two best friends travel from Jerusalem to Krakow for a football match.

items.title: Miracles of the ER
items.synopsis: At Yang-Da University Hospital, Associate Director of Emergency Medicine Chou Cheng-chun makes a bold decision to accept Lin Geng-ming, an average-performing medical school graduate. Lin joins the emergency department as a resident alongside elite peers, Tang Hsi and Chiang Tung-yen, working shoulder to shoulder to save lives. Together with senior attending physician He Yu-hua, the ER team faces relentless medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and internal power struggles within the hospital. Miracles of the ER delves into the complex dynamics between doctors and patients, patients and their families, revealing both the tension and the deep compassion that bind them all together.

items.brief: From comedy stardom to a criminal trial, inside voices and archive footage charts British comedian Russell.

items.brief: After a dance-team initiation goes wrong, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having.

items.title: ChiaroScuro
items.synopsis: Cosmo Speranza is the best art advisor in the business. He can tell whether a work of art is genuine or fake from even the smallest detail. An ability that proves useful when he finds himself working with Rome's Mobile Squad and Inspector Angelo Tiberi. The two are forced to work side by side, discovering that they make an unlikely yet highly effective investigative duo because, just like a painting, a crime scene can also be a forgery. And no one is better than Cosmo at spotting the clues that can bring down the house of cards built by a killer. But when a painting depicting his childhood home is found at a crime scene, it doesn't take Cosmo long to realise that the killer is speaking directly to him, prompting him to reopen the investigation into his father's suicide. A journey between past and present, where it seems impossible to tell truth from fiction.
items.brief: Cosmo Speranza is the best art advisor in the business.

items.title: La Ley de Alicia
items.synopsis: Alicia watches her life come undone when her husband, Aurelio, is found guilty and imprisoned for corruption, after videos surface implicating him in a sex scandal. With her family under public scrutiny, she decides to return to the legal profession after 20 years and rebuild her career to move forward. As she tries to reclaim her professional standing and support her teenage children in this new reality, Alicia begins to question what she wants out of life. A reunion with a past love and changes in her relationship with Aurelio will force her to make a decision: return to the life she once knew, or build a new one on her own terms.
items.brief: Alicia watches her life come undone when her husband, Aurelio, is found guilty and imprisoned for corruption.

items.title: Avedon
items.synopsis: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's…
items.brief: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so.

items.brief: Comedians perform in unscripted drama where failed jokes mean elimination.

items.brief: Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

items.title: Doozie's Doghouse
items.synopsis: Doozie is pinching into her very own Doghouse for some puppy-riffic adventures with her best pup Puggie and all her Doozie Dogs. From the creators of DreamWorks Animation's hit series Gabby's Dollhouse, Doozie's Doghouse is a mixed-media companion series that continues the fun with tail-wagging surprises, woof-tastic unboxings, and imaginative play. Creativity is limitless in Doozie's Doghouse!
items.brief: A dog goes on adventures with her best friend and other dogs.

items.title: The Good Lawyer
items.synopsis: Léonard Landry, a flamboyant criminal defence lawyer, overdoses in the middle of the courtroom. After undergoing rehab, he has one week to save his career and prepare for his own trial, reluctantly assisted by a tenacious intern, Noé. This marks the beginning of a frantic race involving legal manoeuvres,…
items.brief: A criminal defense lawyer must save his career after overdosing in court.

items.title: Palacio
items.synopsis: On November 6, 1985, an M-19 guerrilla commando forcibly entered the Palace of Justice and took more than 300 people hostage, including Supreme Court justices. On November 7, the Colombian Army retook the Palace. Inspired by real and publicly known events, the series recounts what happened during the siege and retaking of the Palace of Justice, which resulted in the deaths and disappearances of at least 94 people, including justices, guerrilla members, civilians and members of the military. It also follows the victims' families in their pursuit of justice for more than 20 years.
items.brief: Series about the 1985 siege of Colombia's Palace of Justice.

items.title: Possible Love
items.synopsis: Working-class An Mi Ok and Choi Ho Seok, who have been together since middle school and are the parents of a taciturn 10-year-old, are still reckoning with the fallout from Ho Seok’s firing from his factory job after a violently suppressed labor union strike. The well-off Lee Ye Ji, a documentary filmmaker, with…
items.brief: Families cope with hardship from a labor union strike's aftermath.

items.title: Black Doves (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Helen Webb, politician's wife, doting mother, and professional spy, has been passing on her husband's secrets to the Black Doves, the shadowy organization for whom she works. But when her lover Jason is assassinated, Helen's life is turned upside down, and only her old friend Sam Young can keep her safe. But Sam, a suave, champagne-drinking assassin, also has problems of his own. Out of the game, since his last job went wrong, he soon realizes his past is coming back to haunt him. Together, they set off on a mission that will lead them to uncover a vast, interconnected conspiracy. One that links the murky underworld of London to a looming geopolitical crisis — and leads them to question the cost of the moral choices they've made.
items.brief: A politician's wife spy and an assassin uncover a vast conspiracy.

items.title: Dilwali Diwali

items.title: High End: The Watch Theft Ring

items.brief: Documentary about a luxury watch smuggling scandal in Chile.

items.title: North of North (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Siaja is a young Inuk mother who wants to build a new future for herself. After a spontaneous — and extremely public — exit from her marriage, Siaja has to find a job and a place for her and her young daughter to live, and fast. Her only option might be to go from one complicated living situation to another — where Siaja's dreams of a fresh start collide with some long-kept secrets. To top it all off, this is happening in a small Arctic town where everybody knows your business.

items.brief: Twenty amateurs get one leg each to beat darts world No. 1 Luke Littler for £501,000.

items.brief: Legendary "SCTV" cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how.

items.brief: A birthday party at a villa spirals into family drama and chaos.

It tackles a wide range of gripping current events, crises, and cultural moments. Every installment moves at the speed of each real-life story and arrives at the height of the conversation.

items.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

items.title: La Caída de El Mayo
items.synopsis: On July 25, 2024, Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada García, co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel and one of the most wanted individuals sought by authorities for decades, landed at a small airport in New Mexico aboard a private plane alongside Joaquín Guzmán López, son of El Chapo, where he was taken into U.S. custody. Was it a kidnapping, a betrayal, or a covert operation?
items.brief: Documentary about drug lord El Mayo's 2024 capture in New Mexico.

items.title: You, Me, Us

items.title: Midnight Diner: Tokyo Stories (Season 3)
items.synopsis: In a back alley of a busy district sits a small eatery called Meshiya, referred to by its patrons as the Midnight Diner. The little joint, which the Master runs by himself, is open only from midnight to 7:00 AM. The menu consists only of a pork miso soup set, beer, saké and shochu, but the Master's policy is to make whatever his customers request. Tonight, like every other night, a menagerie of customers flock to the Midnight Diner, where the bonds among the Master, his food and the patrons set the stage for humorous and sometimes wistful episodes of human drama that feed both the belly and the soul.
items.brief: A late-night diner where customers find warmth, food and connection.

items.title: Dom de Iludir

items.title: The One About Matthew Perry

items.brief: Documentary about Matthew Perry's real life and personal struggles.

items.title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic

items.brief: Zainab Johnson performs stand-up about finding the upside in everything.

items.title: Day of the Dead: Ofrenda
items.synopsis: An ofrenda that never goes dark: Keep this experience glowing and let Day of the Dead fill your space with memory and tradition.
items.brief: An experiential celebration of Day of the Dead tradition.

items.title: WWE Monday Night RAW (Season 33)
items.synopsis: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.
items.brief: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere.

items.title: Minimum Wage

items.brief: Teens run a pizzeria while balancing school and a manic boss.

items.title: The Great Indian Kapil Show (Season 5)

items.title: Screwballs (Season 6)

items.brief: Five siblings face endless missions in this pure entertainment variety show.

items.brief: A gentleman thief seeks revenge for an injustice to his father.

items.brief: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases.

items.title: The Adam Ray Show

items.brief: Same host. Different characters. All chaos.

items.title: Grande de España

The perfect opportunity seems to arise when the immensely wealthy businesswoman Sofía Carrington takes an interest in the property. But as the negotiations (and seductions) progress, it becomes clear that they are not who they appear to be.

items.title: The Rest Is Football (Season 2)

items.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story

items.brief: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco.

items.brief: A corrupt cop's night spirals into crime when he helps an injured girl.

items.title: Nobody Wants This (Season 3)

items.brief: A podcaster and rabbi navigate a complicated relationship and love.

items.title: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
items.synopsis: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.
items.brief: A forgotten actor claws his way back to recognition from zero.

items.brief: Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements.

items.title: Love Is Blind (Season 11)
items.synopsis: With no distractions from the outside world, the singles talk to a stream of potential love interests and when a meaningful connection is made, they propose and then lay their eyes on their fiancé for the first time. Engaged and back in the real world, as the couples plan their wedding day, they will quickly discover whether they can turn their emotional connection into a physical one before the fast-approaching ceremony.
items.brief: With no distractions from the outside world, the singles talk to a stream of potential love interests.

items.brief: An MMA fighter finds her toughest fight is parenting her son.

items.brief: This gripping podcast digs into the most captivating and talked about true crime cases.
